notes: This contract records the bounded portable C++ TCK check for unfinished object and interaction class scaffolds in Create and Join FOM-module unions. The test uses only standard RTIambassador services and standard-library paths; adapter-supplied schema-valid modules control the incomplete/complete union. It checks service failure, failed Join atomicity, and successful retry with a completing module. It does not establish exhaustive class/member completeness or provider conformance.
